triage.kind_span: hereby offers to purchase up to $60,000,000 of its outstanding 4.95% Senior Convertible Notes due 2022

subject_names.span: This Tender Offer Statement on Schedule TO is filed by Prospect Capital Corporation, a Maryland corporation

subject_tickers.span: Our common stock is currently traded on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “PSEC.”

security_class.span: 4.95% Senior Convertible Notes due 2022 (Title of Class of Securities)

price_basis.span: for cash in an amount equal to $1,025.00 per $1,000 principal amount of Notes purchased (exclusive of accrued and unpaid interest on such Notes)

commencement_date.span: The Tender Offer commenced on August 26, 2021 and will expire on the Expiration Date

expiration_date.span: The Tender Offer will expire at 12:00 midnight, New York City time, on September 24, 2021 (one minute after 11:59 P.M., New York City time, on September 23, 2021)

proration.span: If more than $60,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Notes is tendered, all Notes tendered will be purchased on a pro rata basis.

spans: no order, statute, rule, regulation, executive order, stay, decree, judgment or injunction shall have been proposed, enacted, entered, issued, promulgated, enforced or deemed applicable by any court or governmental, regulatory or administrative agency or instrumentality
any general suspension of, or limitation on prices for, trading in securities in the securities or financial markets

there has not occurred any change or development, including a prospective change or development, in our business, financial condition, assets, income, operations, prospects or stock ownership (or that of our subsidiaries) that, in our reasonable judgment, has or is reasonably likely to have a material adverse effect on us

a tender or exchange tender offer for any or all of our shares of common stock, or any merger, acquisition, business combination, strategic transaction or other similar transaction with or involving us or any subsidiary, has not been proposed, announced or made by us or any person

trigger_origin.span: The purpose of the Tender Offer is to reduce the principal amount of outstanding Notes, which mature on July 15, 2022.

notes: Issuer tender offer by a BDC ('We are a closed-end investment company incorporated in Maryland. We have elected to be regulated as a business development company') for its 4.95% Senior Convertible Notes due 2022 (CUSIP 74348TAR3), NOT for shares; security_class=notes. Price is fixed: $1,025.00 per $1,000 principal amount plus accrued interest (102.5% of par; not a NAV basis). Size is stated only as principal: up to $60,000,000 of $111,055,000 outstanding principal, so size_shares (a share count) and size_pct_outstanding are null (60,000,000 / 111,055,000 = 54.0%, my arithmetic, not entered). subject_tickers PSEC is the ticker of the company's COMMON STOCK as printed in the filing; the Notes themselves have no ticker. expiration_date: the filing states '12:00 midnight, New York City time, on September 24, 2021 (one minute after 11:59 p.m. ... on September 23, 2021)', i.e. effectively the end of September 23; 2021-09-24 is the stated date. Expected settlement September 28, 2021 (T+3). The offer is expressly 'not conditioned upon a minimum amount of Notes being tendered'; it is funded from the existing revolving Credit Facility and no financing condition is stated. Conditions mapping (General Conditions): court/regulatory order or injunction (also pending or threatened actions) -> legal_injunction; trading suspension, debt-market impairment, banking moratorium, war -> market_disruption; a material adverse change 'in our reasonable judgment' -> board_discretion (company judgment, not specifically the board's); a competing tender or merger/strategic transaction being proposed -> other (the Trustee/Security Registrar objection condition is also 'other'). trigger_origin board_discretionary is my mapping of the stated purpose (reduce outstanding Notes before their July 15, 2022 maturity); 'other' is the alternative.
